assets.edition: United States, original K-A, NUS-NSME, copyright 1996
limitations: Original US K-A front uses clean 1548 × 1080 Nintendo artwork; rear uses the 4170 × 2916 original scan prepared at 3072 × 2155.

Narrow panels preserve the photographed duotone character art, with exposure and scan-noise correction and clean original title/console marks. Empty fields behind logos are reconstructed approximations; small character details remain limited by the source photograph.
Color normalization is visual, not a calibrated match to physical factory inks.
assets.restorationMethod: Original artwork replacement for the front; original full-resolution rear descreen; bounded compositing of original title/console marks over repaired narrow-panel fields. No generated game illustration.

assets.edition: United States, early round seal, no REV-A, five-screw-era hangtab box
limitations: The original early non-REV-A front illustration and small photographed console wordmark retain limited optical detail. Enlargement does not recover missing print detail.

Top and side title/Nintendo glyphs are recomposited from the matching original rear scan in the specimen layout; readable address and warranty wording is transcribed with an approximate narrow sans-serif.

Fresh black fields replace photographed scuffs. Identifiable printed stars remain; explicitly bounded irregular abrasion and tiny empty-field scan debris are locally repaired. Color is estimated from uncalibrated references.

assets.edition: United States, black label, SNS P MW, copyright 1992
limitations: Edges are a documented reconstruction, not a claim of a new factory-flat scan.
Original rear source is 1143 × 800 pixels; enlargement does not add fine print information.
Original Dry Bones landing artwork is 429 × 438 pixels.
Colors are visually normalized; no physical ink calibration is available.
Gray striped motif and legal-line typeface are close reconstructions with approximately placed layout.
assets.restorationMethod: Original full rear scan restored with a continuous dark-ink curve; three creased lower-right trademark/copyright lines re-typeset with their exact original wording. Four edges reconstructed from archived matching period illustrations, title lettering and front-scan Nintendo capsule, with clean flat ink fields. Original side legal line re-typeset and gray striped motif traced from specimen. No generative imagery.
assets.editionEvidence: The retained front and original rear share the US black-label layout; rear retains copyright 1992, SNS P MW, UPC 045496830014, original four printed screenshots and North American legal copy. Original side specimen photographs establish the different flying/diving poses and the original Nintendo of America address.

assets.edition: European Mega Drive, cream/pink grid, 670-1470-50S, copyright 1991
limitations: Complete original European outer wrap and manual covers; no printed reverse-side outer wrap is asserted.

The spine empty black/grid field is reconstructed from measured spacing to remove fold glare and dust; original title and logo pixels remain. Luminance/chroma filtering reduces scanner noise without recovering unseen detail.

assets.edition: United States, SCUS-94900, original black label K-A, standard clear-tray jewel case
limitations: Complete four-part original SCUS-94900 print set, including both exterior rear spines. Separate luminance/chroma descreen reduces coarse scan grain; fine rear type uses a gentler kernel.
Known plain-black spine and trim fields are restored while original artwork remains; scans are not color-calibrated print proofs.

Clear tray is verified by the documented physical US specimen. Updated neutral-template clear-plastic alpha fallback preserves readability in Godot Compatibility while making molded edges visible; exact reflections vary by renderer.
